name: Bevacizumab
mechanism: Humanised IgG1 that neutralises VEGF-A, inhibiting tumour angiogenesis, normalising tumour vasculature and potentially enhancing delivery of chemotherapy and immune infiltration. Biosimilars are widely available.
keyToxicities: Haemorrhage, including haemoptysis (contraindicated in squamous NSCLC with significant haemoptysis)
monitoring: Withhold around surgery to allow wound healing
resistance: Upregulation of alternative pro-angiogenic factors and vessel co-option.
